topic: Database access and organizational membership setup
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on onboarding a new data science team member. Initial steps involved providing database credentials for ClickHouse and PostgreSQL, along with instructions on how to test the databases in read-only mode. Later, [p1] requested addition to the [p2] organization, which was advised against until approval from a senior manager (Anatolii Lapytskyi) due to membership limitations.
decisions: Provided connection strings for PostgreSQL and ClickHouse databases.
action_items: New member needs high-level approval for organizational membership.
